name: Donchian LWTI Volume Confluence [Manual Build] [Medium]
raw_text: Donchian LWTI Volume Confluence (New Batch 4, Strategy 5). Bias TF 1H (Donchian, length=96), Entry TF 15m (LWTI period=25/smoothing=20, Volume MA length=30). New but standard (non-proprietary) indicators. Sequence (AND, all 3 required): (1) Donchian breakout/breakdown on the bias role -- a band held flat for >=8 of the last 10 bars (own default) then making a genuinely new 96-bar high/low; the breakout state stays 'active' for up to 8 entry-TF bars (~2h, own default) once merged onto the 15m entry frame, so the other two legs have a real window to confirm; (2) LWTI (own deterministic reconstruction -- multiple community LWTI implementations exist and the source gives no exact formula matching its own '+50/-50' banding, flagged as a builder default) green above +50 for long / red below -50 for short; (3) current volume above its 30-period MA. HARD FILTER: if Donchian breaks out but LWTI or Volume don't confirm, skip entirely (source's own explicit warning). SL = Donchian mid-line (bias role) -- own choice verified safer than the raw swing-low/high alternative via cost_model.check_buffer_safety() (0.65% buffer). TP = structure-based (nearest swing-high/low), single target (engine is single-exit; source's optional multi-target mention simplified away). Risk 1% default, no session restriction.
